about: The fixed-width text (docs/pipeline.md 3.6-3.9). Edit only en. party, items, enemies: name fields, width in cells, padded with an end code and spaces. kind tilemap: menu words stored as glyph-table tiles in a VDP tilemap, one cell a character, cells wide, upper: the run owns the row above (the JP dakuten row; in the US font only " and the apostrophe use it). kind readonly (naming screen, credits): jp and us only, not written back.

name_boxes.about: The four one-name boxes (LABEL_B27_B40B, 36 bytes each).

status_boxes.about: The battle status boxes, a name centred in 6 cells over the HP and MP row (LABEL_B27_B4AB-B53B).

spells.about: The six spell lists (LABEL_B27_B6DF, 12 rows of 6 cells each; LABEL_3478 picks one: Noah is list 2, field magic adds 3). The window shows 2n+1 rows for n known spells. The spells have no other name table.

inventory.about: The inventory's "next page" row, drawn from 9 items (LABEL_B27_BAF7).

item_menu.about: What to do with an item (LABEL_B27_BC0F).

status_labels.about: The status window's labels (bank 0 LABEL_3881-38B1, one row each; the value follows in the same row). Their upper row is the shared blank row LABEL_B27_BCDB, so a run here has no upper tiles of its own (the JP's dakuten sit in its JP copy). LV and EP (LABEL_3865, LABEL_3875) are window tiles, not text.

money.about: The meseta label (bank 0 LABEL_3639). The money box shows its first 3 cells; the status window shows 5, the last 2 blank.

save_slots.about: The save-slot list (bank 0 LABEL_3AC4): only the slot numbers, one cell; the rest of each row is left blank. It is copied to save RAM ($8100) when the save RAM is formatted and drawn from there, so a change shows only on a fresh save RAM.

spaceport.about: The spaceport destinations (bank 18 LABEL_B18_BE84, 7 x 8 cells, via LABEL_3A21). The JP menu is a 8 x 5 map at 03:BEB2, drawn at $7AAA.

intro_caption.about: The caption before the intro (bank 18 LABEL_B18_BEF4, 5 x 20 cells at $7886; LABEL_B18_BF20-BF80 fall inside it). The JP caption is a 5 x 15 map at 03:BF02 with its own tiles $B8-$BF (from 10:BF5E): A, W, 年, $BB, 星, $BD, $BE, 区 ($BB, $BD and $BE are kanji not read with certainty: perhaps 春, and 街 for $BE).

naming_screen.about: The naming screen (US LABEL_423C, unpacked by LABEL_4166; JP 01:4406, unpacked by 01:42DA, consecutive tiles with no blank between). Read-only: gentext does not write it. A new grid also needs a new key table (LABEL_4280).

credits.about: The staff credits (LABEL_B20_BDB8: screens 2-15, each a list of (row, col, ASCII) records in the credits font, A-Z only; us_at/jp_at give each record's row and column). Read-only: whether to translate them is the owner's call. The JP is ASCII too; the US adds FINOS PATA.
